description: This file defines a React functional component 'SelectedRevisionContent' that displays a note revision, either using a component viewer or a textarea based on note type. It manages component viewer lifecycle with hooks and interfaces with application controllers and models.

classes.name: SelectedRevisionContent
classes.description: React functional component that renders the content of a selected revision, either as a component viewer or editable/text area depending on note type.

methods.name: useMemo
methods.description: Memoizes the creation of the component viewer based on dependencies.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: Handles cleanup for component viewer destruction when the component unmounts or dependencies change.
